I fixed the "Allah Ahmed" outline, and the page is updated at the same link.

The outline looked wrong because Montserrat's letters are built from overlapping shapes. A thin outline draws through those overlaps, so you could see extra lines inside the letters. Now the stroke is drawn behind a dark fill, which hides those inner lines. I also made the stroke a bit thicker and the letter spacing slightly looser so the letters don't touch.

The dark fill also covers the wireframe shape behind the name, so the letters may look slightly solid where they overlap it. If you'd rather have the see-through outline back, or a solid orange "Allah Ahmed" instead, I can switch it.
